nieuw.titel: Wait before exposing a light scorer on the central objective
nieuw.tekst: If claiming the central objective would expose a light scoring unit, consider leaving it until other units can come across. The speaker thinks he should have waited rather than trying to collect cheap early points.
nieuw.waarom: He considers the central objective particularly vulnerable. His attempt to claim it exposed his scoring unit to Ruby Ring, which reduced it below scoring strength.
nieuw.voorbeeld: He moved a light unit forward to claim the other objective and draw the opponent towards him. Ruby Ring killed four models, leaving two that could no longer score; it killed the remainder the following turn.
